scope: Saved historical WikiTree father-certainty flags, through 1850

later_non_biological_exclusions.reason: Saved non-biological tree flag; outside every measured cohort

method: Use the saved tree_status only when the general status is unknown or unassessed. Explicit research assessments remain authoritative, including uncertain, possible and contradicted assessments. Unknown and explicitly unmarked remain distinct. Non-biological and superseded relationships are excluded.
baseline_limit: The original method-2 baseline remains immutable. Its confidence-only figures must not be used for direct progress comparisons with method 3; the working baseline remains comparable.
history: The added snapshot is labelled method_correction and records zero new genealogical connections. Existing figures are not rewritten.
